summary: Zentek Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the formation of a U.S. joint venture, Strategic Graphite Partners LLC, with ALO Graphite Partners LLC. The JV is 90% owned by a Zentek subsidiary and 10% by ALO Partners. Zentek granted 50,000 stock options (C$0.56, 24-month term) to consultants Jeremy Roenick and Nicolas Perkin. The JV aims to advance Albany ultra-high-purity graphite sales in U.S. national-security markets. No price, premium, or deal terms were disclosed. The filing reports a business development, not a special situation.
